milestone: M21 External Mode Pack Execution Policy

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Direct tasks started from workspace Mode Pack modes carry bounded policy provenance and cannot enter task.run execution unless the current workspace Mode Pack still matches that provenance.
The Rust runtime denies stale, deleted, malformed, or changed external Mode Pack task policy before TaskRunning, provider calls, tools, workspace mutation, or child materialization.
Headless callers can resume delayed external-mode tasks with replay-safe assurance that current workspace Mode Pack policy is revalidated at execution time.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances mode_pack_runtime with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Direct external Mode Pack tasks persist bounded external_modepack_task_provenance and task.run revalidates the current workspace Mode Pack before TaskRunning.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M12.2 validates external child provenance only for materialized child tasks. Direct task.start/task.run for external modes could rely on a frozen ModeResolved payload after .brownie/modepack.json was deleted or changed.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie would continue to treat external Mode Packs as loadable policies but not enforce current policy freshness for direct external-mode task execution.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M20.2 ran provider retry tasks, M20.1 admitted provider retry tasks, and M19.2 carried context budgets into headless execution; none revalidate external Mode Pack policy for direct task.run.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This changes existing task.start/task.run behavior and ledger evidence; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The result is an execution-time denial gate and bounded ledger event, not a new report, digest, history, preview, readiness, or inspection summary.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: task.run now denies direct external Mode Pack tasks before TaskRunning when current Mode Pack policy is missing, malformed, changed, or fingerprint-mismatched.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can safely run external-mode tasks after delays because Rust revalidates current Mode Pack policy at the moment of execution.
answers.milestone_progress: Establishes the first M21 direct external Mode Pack execution-policy slice, complementing existing M12 child-provenance behavior.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M21.1 must be reviewed for actual direct external Mode Pack task.run denial behavior before TaskRunning, not for a new inspection surface.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M21.1 changes the current phase manifest only; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: task.start for a direct workspace Mode Pack mode records bounded external_modepack_task_provenance in ModeResolved
task.run for an unchanged direct external Mode Pack task revalidates current policy and can complete normally
deleted workspace Mode Pack policy denies before TaskRunning with ExternalModePackTaskProvenanceDenied evidence
changed workspace Mode Pack policy denies before TaskRunning with fingerprint mismatch evidence
malformed workspace Mode Pack policy denies before TaskRunning without exposing raw Mode Pack content
replaying a denied direct external Mode Pack task does not append duplicate denial or TaskRunning evidence
built-in mode tasks and M12.2 external child provenance behavior remain on existing paths

ledger/RPC evidence contains bounded identifiers and no raw Mode Pack file content, prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environment values, secrets, absolute paths, or canonical paths
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M21.1 merge, consider a distinct M21.2 headless routing slice that refuses to select stale external Mode Pack tasks, or close M21 if direct task execution policy is sufficient. Reject Mode Pack reports, histories, readiness wrappers, registries, downloads, and VSIX-owned policy.
